## Status: FILE ONLY / UNROUTED
Guy authorized redesign scoping and issue filing, not dispatch, implementation, fleet resume, PR, merge or release. No labels or assignees. Visual implementation requires approved prototype evidence and separate routing approval.

## Preserved contract
Accepted V1 panorama + R2 ranch environment + original V1 horse design and corrected grazing anatomy. Native procedural SwiftUI Canvas/Path with distinct/exportable layers; no flattened raster scene, video backdrop, WebView, new engine or service dependency. Same authoritative live model, filters, composite identities, blocked rail and Recent Output destination. Preserve truthful offline/unknown states and accessible operation. Day/Night/Auto environment remains independent of the app's Catppuccin preference. No daemon, SSE, pairing, grant, APNs or release work.

## Owner-selected interaction direction
1. Full-screen ranch scene with floating TOP HUD (scope + Settings), compact BOTTOM paddock navigation. Background extends behind safe areas; controls remain safe-area-aware. Do not hide the system status bar/home indicator simply to claim full-screen.
2. Settings controls the saved Board/Herd mode, applies immediately and restores on launch. Remove the prominent top Board/Herd switch. Retain the Open Board recovery action.
3. Full gentle ambience: shared wind, swaying leaves/grass, drifting clouds and slow night-sky motion. No weather system, sound, seasons, leaf storm or shooting-star extras.

## Proposed details to validate visually (not separately owner-locked)
Ranch-context Day/Night glass HUD and filter treatment, with native accessible fallbacks; Board and general Settings keep their established app theme. Preserve Board as the no-preference migration default rather than silently choosing Herd for everyone. Open Board recovery is a temporary override, not an implicit rewrite of the saved preference. Confirm these details in the prototype gate before implementation.

## Grounding / why this is a follow-up
Inspected main 86d1287a9e5c611ec6bef677c95544c53e71b982:
- FleetViews.swift:788-805 places the shared filter header above HerdView; 957-970 adds the persistent Board/Herd principal toolbar.
- HerdView.swift:68-90 places summary/outage above the bounded environment; summary/HUD text uses ThemeStore rather than a unified ranch context.
- RanchEnvironment.swift:57-90 already has star twinkle and very small cloud oscillation; 144-152 tree canopy geometry is static; 165-174 grass already bends.
- AppModel.fleetPresentation is an in-memory Board default; SettingsView at FleetViews.swift:3071-3073 already hosts Appearance and HerdEnvironmentSettings.
This does not claim all ambient motion is absent. The top/header mismatch is user-reported and code-grounded, not newly captured physical evidence.

## Bounded design deliverable
Produce two materially different HUD/control-density treatments WITHIN the selected top-HUD/bottom-navigation layout: compact single-row glass controls versus a more readable two-level status/scope cluster. Recommend one after phone checks. Do not reopen Panorama versus Map or change horse/ranch art.
Show full-screen Day and Night, scope/filter sheet, Settings mode picker, dense/blocked/offline/empty states, Dynamic Type and Reduce Motion. Demonstrate wind and sky in a playable motion prototype, clearly labeled prototype. HTML may be disposable design proof only; shipping remains native procedural Swift.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Phone-tappable comparison gallery with both treatments, recommendation, labeled screenshots and motion clips; variants differ in information density/hierarchy, not palette alone.
- [ ] Background reaches screen edges while status bar, notch/home indicator, top HUD and bottom controls remain readable and tappable; no separate opaque Board header above the scene.
- [ ] Scope, host health, blocked attention and Settings remain discoverable. No visual simplification hides offline/key-mismatch states or active filters.
- [ ] Settings -> saved mode change -> dismiss shows the chosen mode; return/relaunch restores it. Open Board recovery remains reachable and preference semantics are explicit.
- [ ] All owner-selected direction and proposed defaults are reconciled in one final approved specification; no silent change to locked art or Board theme.
- [ ] Verify prototype reachability, safe areas at small/large phone widths, tap targets >=44pt, readable long labels, contrast and Reduce Motion/static alternative.
- [ ] Package reproducible evidence and provenance under docs/design/evidence/issue-<N>/ plus phone gallery link; no production code changes in this design slice.
- [ ] Stop at PROTOTYPE — awaiting Guy visual approval. Filing these children does not start them.

## Relationship and split
Design follow-up to #442/#444, not a replacement of the accepted art. Existing #448 owns horse-leg gait; #449 owns active-repository ordering. Neither is duplicated or auto-routed. Child work will separately own shell, filter treatment, preference, wind/foliage, and sky. Each child must carry its own tests and actual-app evidence; no giant cleanup PR.

## Filed child map — all UNROUTED

- [ ] #456 — Herd: extend the ranch full-screen with floating top HUD and bottom paddock controls
- [ ] #457 — Herd: align floating controls and filter sheet with ranch Day/Night context
- [ ] #458 — iOS Settings: persist Board/Herd mode and remove the top mode switch
- [ ] #459 — Herd ambience: add coherent wind-driven tree canopy and grass motion
- [ ] #460 — Herd ambience: add gentle cloud drift and slow moving night sky

## Bounded sequencing (not dispatch)
1. #455 visual prototype and owner approval first.
2. #458 preference can be a small standalone slice after approval; #456 shell then #457 contextual controls/sheet. Serialize shared FleetViews.swift edits; no duplicate toolbar ownership.
3. #459 wind/foliage owns shared ambient timing/power policy; #460 sky consumes it afterward. Serialize RanchEnvironment.swift edits. Shell and renderer work may proceed independently only after normal routing/admission.
4. Existing #448 gait and #449 activity ordering remain separate, file-only and unchanged.

Each child owns its focused tests, native runtime evidence and applicable CI. Physical iPhone screenshots/video are required before visual/motion claims pass; prototype evidence does not prove production behavior. No omnibus implementation PR required, and no release authorization implied.

## DESIGN DISPATCH — owner approved prototype only
Guy: “Ok have designer with GPT Astra do prototype?”

Started a conductor-owned one-shot designer run for #455, using the explicitly requested model via per-run override (shared profile configuration unchanged). This supersedes FILE ONLY for the #455 prototype only. Corral implementation fleet stays paused; #456–460 plus #448/#449 remain UNROUTED.

- Profile: designer; provider openai-codex; model gpt-6-astra; reasoning high.
- Verified live session: 20260909_172903_3b8fd1; process PID 82812. Completion notification armed.
- Brief: /Users/jirathip/design-output/corral/455-immersive-herd/.brief.md
- Output: /Users/jirathip/design-output/corral/455-immersive-herd/
- Two treatments within the selected floating-top-HUD/bottom-navigation layout; Day/Night, functional filters/Settings mode, gentle wind/leaves/clouds/night-sky motion, screenshots, real-time clips, reproducible browser verification and SHA manifest.
- Locked ranch/horse art preserved; reads exact main source rather than stale primary checkout. No product edits, commits/pushes, PRs, release or fleet resume in this run. Stop at PROTOTYPE — awaiting Guy approval.
